title: bundle: shared readBundleSessionOrThrow helper — fix raw-ENOENT twins in writeLoopCheckpoint + setMode
description: FOLLOW-UP advised by the TASK-088 reviewer (LOW, FOLLOWUP-2): writeLoopCheckpoint (src/loop-checkpoint.js:72) and setMode (src/operating-mode.js:57) still surface a raw ENOENT for the identical missing-bundle-dir case TASK-088 fixed one seam over in loop-auth.js — same user-facing symptom. Reviewer-suggested shape: an ADDITIVE readBundleSessionOrThrow(repoRoot, sessionId, callerLabel) export in src/bundle.js (does not change readBundleSession's throw shape, preserving TASK-088's blast-radius argument), then migrate the three call sites (loop-auth.js can drop its local wrap). RIDERS folded in: (a) TASK-088 review LOW — the structural Object.isFrozen lock in tests/loop-auth.spec.js is mechanism-redundant beside the behavioral mutation locks; drop it when touching the file. (b) TASK-088 review ASIDE — tests/e2e/dist-parity.spec.js test title still says four bundles while ENTRYPOINT_NAMES has six; fix the title (coverage itself is correct, it iterates the list). Tier tdd per the E2 bright line: touches source logic in state-adjacent modules.
acceptance_criteria: src/bundle.js exports readBundleSessionOrThrow(repoRoot, sessionId, callerLabel) throwing typed E_BUNDLE_MISSING naming session id + expected path; readBundleSession itself unchanged (existing callers unaffected — locked by existing suites staying green).
writeLoopCheckpoint and setMode use it; both surface the typed error for the missing-bundle-dir case (red-green-proven specs, tests-first per tdd).
loop-auth.js migrates to the shared helper, dropping its local wrap; its existing E_BUNDLE_MISSING locks stay green unmodified.
Riders: redundant Object.isFrozen structural lock removed from tests/loop-auth.spec.js; dist-parity spec title says six (or derives the count from ENTRYPOINT_NAMES.length).
Bundling check: bundle.js IS reachable via close-guard -> mcp-server -> dist; rebuild dist and commit if bundles change; dist-parity green.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: RIDER added (from the TASK-089 developer hand-off, out-of-scope flag): src/mcp-server.js:22 module-header JSDoc still says 'all six tools registered' while line 7 of the same header says seven — fix the stale comment when touching source for this ticket. Note this file IS a dist entrypoint: AC5's rebuild-and-commit-dist requirement covers whether the comment change alters dist/mcp-server.cjs (esbuild may or may not strip it — let dist-parity decide).
